verdict.rationale: Cekura's marketing and docs describe AI-generated insights: LLM-judge metrics that evaluate calls with natural-language criteria, live drift detection, and a stated pipeline where 'Cekura flags issues → reproduces in simulation → suggests fixes automatically,' plus dashboards to analyze call data/metrics. This directly matches the story of surfacing AI-generated insights/suggestions from the product's own data. Missing for 10: deeper technical documentation of how 'suggested fixes' are generated/validated, and independent hands-on corroboration specifically of the insight/suggestion feature (the only community mention is general praise, not feature-specific).
